description: This PHP source file is responsible for displaying a list of workflow tasks in the VTiger CRM system. It sets up dependencies, checks user permissions, retrieves tasks via the VTTaskManager class, and renders an HTML template to present those tasks.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering the output HTML page.

classes.name: VTTaskManager
classes.description: Manages workflow tasks, providing methods to retrieve task lists.

classes.name: VTWorkflowApplication
classes.description: Represents the workflow module within VTiger, providing module-specific information.

classes.name: VTWorkflowUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing common workflow-related functions such as access checks and URL redirection.

methods.name: vtDisplayTaskList
methods.description: Main function that checks admin access, retrieves workflow tasks, and renders the task list page.
